individual_variation_bound.source: Al-Majdoub et al. 2019, 22 donors, frontal cortex microvessels, targeted mass spectrometry
individual_variation_bound.meaning: The receptor a ligand targets varies about 13-14 fold between people and none of that variation was explained by age or sex. Lifestyle and demographic features cannot stand in for measuring the receptor.
